scope: Uncommitted TF09 implementation and connected common/selected adapter paths; pinned upstream sources inspected, not a whole-repository audit.

findings.issue: Common optional web fields could replace supplied selected options with undefined; selected projection shapes differ by renderer.
findings.resolution: Only supplied common constructor/render fields override options; Mapbox name and MapLibre type shapes are forwarded correctly.
findings.verification: Focused web mapping/reset tests and four TypeScript projects.

findings.issue: Terrain inputs needed runtime validation, including sparse coordinate arrays, non-string sources and invalid projection values.
findings.resolution: Validate at the common/terrain query boundary with explicit finite coordinate indices.
findings.verification: 13 focused common validation cases plus query/adapter tests.

findings.issue: Native RNMapbox no-data elevation could crash on iOS or reject as an operational error on Android.
findings.resolution: Narrow source/compiled wrapper and Android bridge patch preserves no-data null, zero and actual failures.
findings.verification: Executable peer patch regression, native adapter tests, fresh iOS/Android builds; runtime outcomes recorded separately.

findings.issue: Terrain null must disable terrain already present in the native base style.
findings.resolution: Use existing RNMapbox Terrain transport with narrow omitted-source disable support; keyed attachment separates enabled and disabled states.
findings.verification: Native component mapping/reset tests, peer patch assertions, fresh native builds; renderer gate separate.

findings.issue: Native style declarations must not require web renderer peers.
findings.resolution: Use facade-owned structural native style roots and preserve the pinned SDK nested JSON typing boundary; repair upstream NodeNext declaration links.
findings.verification: Four isolated packed peer consumers and package selection checks.

findings.issue: Custom source/layer creation inputs and mutable slot updates need explicit supported lifetimes.
findings.resolution: Reuse existing stable creation guards for media identity and callback sets; keep coordinates mutable; add one Mapbox slot effect with a generated id when omitted.
findings.verification: Focused immutable-input, coordinate forwarding, slot update/reset and retained-ref tests; media runtime gate separate.

findings.issue: Residual inventory review identified missing public debug/property/global access.
findings.resolution: Add Mapbox 2D/3D wireframes and supported probe, both selected renderer version getters, and MapLibre cancellation getter/setter. Resolve 106 residual aliases with individual routes or source-backed boundaries.
findings.verification: 13 selected tests, upstream signature assertions in four isolated peer consumers, all 438 aliases reviewed.

assessment: No known unresolved implementation finding after the recorded fixes. Runtime acceptance is a separate gate; consult tf09-acceptance.json for current results.
notChecked: Upstream renderer internals and every SDK layer/operator/global configuration combination are not independently certified; representative integration and pinned forwarding/types define this checkpoint.

acceptanceReview.limitation: Initial Mapbox Android startup timeout did not reproduce; same patched APK passed on retry.
